question: What screen-quality or touchscreen feedback is reported for the Galaxy S20 FE?
answer:
One reviewer reported pretty horrendous ghosting when testing the S20 FE in a touchscreen test app and called it undeniably a hardware issue. [5a3eda0efa5d_3]
That reviewer said updates since release had not fixed the issue entirely, describing them as merely a band-aid. [5a3eda0efa5d_3]
The same reviewer said they had not noticed the touchscreen issue in everyday use, though pinching or zooming with fingers close together caused the screen to jitter. [5a3eda0efa5d_3]
One reviewer with a Galaxy S20+ said that besides the screen size they had not been able to tell a notable difference from the S20 FE. [93e465586633_0]
Another reviewer said the S20 FE 5G is bigger than the other S20 models. [33312e22e9fc_0]

And yes, my phone (ordered in early November) has the issue too. Pretty horrendous ghosting when testing it in the touchscreen test app. There's undeniably a hardware issue with the S20 FE. There have been updates since the phone released, but none have fixed it entirely; merely a band-aid on a bloody gash. The real question is: does it affect everyday use? Will you notice it every moment you use the S20 FE? The answer to both is no, at least for me. While I'm sure it does affect certain tasks (most notably those that involve fast touches or 3+ fingers), I really haven't noticed it in actual use. Pinching/zooming with your fingers close together will cause the screen to jitter, but that's about all I've seen. If that worries you enough to pass on the S20 FE, I don't blame you.
